annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents a front-running and sandwich-trading bot as an easy income mechanism and links its claimed profits to transactions placed around another user's transaction. It instructs viewers to deploy and fund the contract with BNB, says larger funding can produce more profit, and claims that most profits are automatically returned to the viewer's wallet. Reported weekly returns and profitability claims reinforce the promotional financial context, although it includes a non-guarantee disclaimer and does not independently verify the bot, its code, or the claimed outcomes.
